scope: Proposition 34 (Observation interpretation) of the manuscript “Weak and strong normalization in pure type systems” (preprints/Weak-and-strong-normalization-in-pure-type-systems-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 245 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9db295a439634e31), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume system-wide weak normalization and (7). Then (30) gives candidates with the required weakening and context-conversion invariance and nonempty parameter extensions. It has the product test clause and the specialization property: if T = Πx : D.E is generic normalized of profile in S, Γ ⊢ N : D, and Nξ passes its domain test, then the test of a candidate member h entails h (Nξ) ∈ R(E[N/x])# (ξ, θ). The ordinary typed-SN clause applies when the instantiated actual profile lies in U.
